description: A Murakumo-only LLM factual trend description over one or more narashi.metricObservation records for a jurisdiction. R0 skeleton per ADR-2607101800 SS3/SS6. CONSTITUTIONAL: `nonAdjudicatingNotice` is a required const `true` -- the narrative states FACTUAL trend descriptions only (e.g. 'gini for jurisdiction X moved from A in year Y1 to B in year Y2'); it MUST NOT rank the jurisdiction, assign blame, or recommend policy (G4). `murakumoInferenceAttestation` is required -- a vendor-LLM origin is unrepresentable at the schema layer (G7).

metricObservationCids.description: >=2 CIDs establishing the trend the narrative describes

nonAdjudicatingNotice.description: Structural invariant (G4) -- MUST always be true.

narrativeText.description: Factual, source-cited trend description only. No ranking, no merit judgment, no policy recommendation.

murakumoInferenceAttestation.description: Attestation that this narrative was generated on the Murakumo fleet only (ADR-2605215000); required, non-optional (G7)
